card.name: Category noun after a proper name
card.fires_on: A generic category noun such as bacteria, system, magazine, tree or protein that follows a specific name (organism, product, publication, gene). It also fires on the word just before it, such as operating or the end of observatory.

modes.label: Organism or gene plus type noun
modes.description: The noun bacteria, protein or tree comes right after a species or gene name.
modes.example: Infections due to Escherichia coli<< bacteria>> can cause severe, bloody diarrhea.

modes.label: Product or publication plus type noun
modes.description: The noun system, magazine or observatory completes a named product or outlet.
modes.example: published in Time<< magazine>> in 1994, reported

card.writes: It suggests that a text-ending noun has just closed a name, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated multilingual pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on the plain category word, like bacteria or magazine, that follows a specific name.
